sam (pm): Heads-up: team asked for a narrower deprecation policy for long-lived pins. They want a predictable cutover for customers on FP16 older forks. Need to formalize in the model catalog lifecycle doc.

drew (eng): Can we add a 'grace extension' flow for enterprise accounts who need extra time?

maya (eng-ml): We'll need to define the tech constraints: pin lifetime, auto-collapse to latest minor, and migration telemetry.

tom (sales): Sales asks for a standard opt-in SOW template for pin extensions.

opsbot: ticket created #MC-402 for pin-extension-template.

sam (pm): OK will draft a doc; keeping thread short.
